title: Fists
content:
# Fists

# Introduction

Fists is a weapon class.

## Description

When a player attacks without a weapon, tool equipped, or use a dedicated Fist weapon such as the Flesh Rippers, they do a Fist strike. The primary attack is a punch, and the secondary attack is a kick that does additional knockback with 6x staggering. The punch has a 2-hit combo where the second punch (left hand) does double damage.
Bare fists can be useful against the weakest of enemies; especially when the player wants to avoid the cost of weapon durability. It also costs less stamina than most weapons.

## List of Fists

• Name: Bare fists | Damage: blunt: 5 | Knockback: 5 | Stamina: 4

• Name: Paws of the Bear | Damage: slash: 25/37 | Knockback: 10 | Stamina: 6

• Name: Flesh Rippers | Damage: slash: 60/72 | Knockback: 20 | Stamina: 10

• Name: Vilebone Maulclaws | Damage: pierce: 60 slash: 20/32 | Knockback: 10 | Stamina: 12

## Properties

• Attack type: Fist (primary) | Stamina: 1x | Range: 2 m | Attack speed: 1.48 s (0.76 + 0.72) | Damage: 1x + 2x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 20

• Attack type: Kick (secondary) | Stamina: 2x | Range: 2 m | Attack speed: 1.48 s | Damage: 1x | Staggering: 6x | Knockback: 80

## Notes

• Fists was previously named Unarmed prior to the Frost Caves update.

Categorias: Weapons, Unarmed
